rows.name: soccer
rows.caption: Two people are playing football while a white ball lies nearby.

rows.name: farm
rows.caption: A person wearing light clothing holds a rope while leading a brown horse outdoors. A fire is burning in the foreground. Farther back, another horse is in the field.

rows.name: motorcycle
rows.caption: A man is riding a dirt bike. Large rocks and grass on the ground next to the water. A brown motorcycle is visible behind them. He is wearing a red jacket and orange pants. He has a helmet on his head and goggles on his eyes. The bike has a number on the front of it.

rows.name: bicycle
rows.caption: One person is carrying a handbag. Another person can also be seen nearby. A bicycle is visible behind them.

rows.name: baseball
rows.caption: A young person is swinging a baseball bat at a white ball.

rows.name: kitchen
rows.caption: Two people are in a kitchen around a dining table. A white refrigerator, a brown couch, an oven, a sink, and a tv are visible behind them. A beige cup and a brown vase sit on the table, while 4 brown chairs surround it.

rows.name: dense
rows.caption: Outdoors, a person is playing with a tennis racket, while several other people remain farther back.

rows.name: animal
rows.caption: A bear is at the heart of the scene.
